title: 第十一章 否认三连
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
此刻，摆在萧京溪或者说季南北面前的，是一碟色泽金黄的金丝虾球。

    这道菜季南北在穿越之前就颇为喜爱。

    没成想，穿越之后竟还能尝到这道菜肴。

    而且，这金丝虾球所用的材料皆是上等灵膳，与普通食材相比，无论是口感还是风味，都不可同日而语。

    季南北对它也格外青睐。

    自从萧京溪察觉这一点后，在季南北离开的间隙，这位小剑仙便特意嘱咐了自己的侍女，要求每日早膳都备上这道菜。

    事实上，除了之前那次因特殊召见需前往太玄殿用膳外，其余时候萧京溪都是在自家房中用早膳的。

    况且，仙灵剑宗也只设早膳，并无午膳或晚膳。

    与其说这是餐食，不如说是宗门给予真传与内门弟子的一项福利。

    外门弟子，也就是小侍女那一层级，是没有资格享用这份早膳的。

    而内门弟子的早膳，用料普通，只是些寻常灵食，对修炼虽有益处，但也效果一般。

    唯有亲传弟子，每日清晨才能享用品质最佳的灵膳早膳。

    不过，能自行点菜的，恐怕也只有萧京溪这位地位超然的小剑仙了。

    即便小剑仙提出每日都要吃金丝虾球，宗内也无人觉得她是恃宠而骄，特立独行。那么好看的一位小剑仙，每天就想吃个金丝虾球，怎么了!!!

    季南北拈起一枚金丝虾球送入口中，脸上露出满足的神情。

    快乐有时就是这么简单!

    “喂......'“

    少女的声音轻轻响起。

    季南北停下了动作。

    “怎么啦?”

    对待这只可爱的小剑仙，季南北除了偶尔想逗弄一下之外，平日还是挺温和的。

    “认识这么久了，我还不知道你的名字呢。”

    [触发任务，请从以下三个选项中选择一项进行回复。】

    选项一:我不叫喂，我叫季南北!(奖励:二十万魔道点，五品灵宝“化血飞刀”。)

    选项二:我不认为我们的关系已亲密到可以互通名讳!(奖励:两万魔道点，三品秘典《驭房神术》。)人5

    选项三:随口编些话应付。(奖励:三千魔道点，随机三品灵符一张。)

    季南北扫了一眼选项，心里便有数了。

    说实在的，选项二又搞这种调调，季南北都快习惯了。

    说起来，季南北发现，自己身份暴露的风险似乎正在逐渐降低。

    “吾之名讳承载着强大的诅咒，知晓之人，将为这世间招来灾厄!”

    【获得三千魔道点，“避水符”已存入系统空间。】“诶诶诶!?竟然还有这种事!难怪你一直不肯告诉我你的名字。”

    萧京溪讶然道。
content_en:
At this moment, what was placed in front of Xiao Jingxi or Ji Nanbei was a plate of golden shrimp balls.

    Ji Bei and Nan were very fond of this dish before they traveled across the country.

    Unexpectedly, I could taste this dish after traveling through time.

    Moreover, the ingredients used in this golden shrimp ball are all high-quality spiritual food. Compared with ordinary ingredients, both the taste and flavor are completely different.

    Ji Nanbei also liked it very much.

    Ever since Xiao Jingxi noticed this, when Ji Nanbei left, the little sword fairy specially asked his maid to prepare this dish for breakfast every day.

    In fact, except for the previous time when he had to go to Taixuan Hall for dinner due to a special summons, Xiao Jingxi had breakfast in his room at other times.

    Moreover, the Xianling Sword Sect only provides breakfast meals, and no lunch or dinner meals.

    Rather than saying this is a meal, it is better to say it is a benefit given by the sect to the true disciples and inner disciples.

    Outer disciples, that is, the level of young maids, are not eligible to enjoy this breakfast.

    As for the breakfast meal for the inner disciples, the ingredients are ordinary, just some ordinary spiritual food. Although it is beneficial to cultivation, the effect is mediocre.

    Only direct disciples can enjoy the best quality spiritual breakfast every morning.

    However, the only one who can order food on his own is Xiao Jingxi, a young swordsman with a transcendent status.

    Even if the little sword fairy proposed to eat golden shrimp balls every day, no one in the sect thought that she was arrogant and independent. Such a good-looking little swordsman wants to eat golden shrimp balls every day, what’s wrong!!!

    Ji Nanbei picked up a golden shrimp ball and put it into his mouth, with a satisfied look on his face.

    Happiness is sometimes that simple!

    "Hey...'"

    The girl's voice sounded softly.

    Ji Nanbei stopped moving.

    "What's wrong?"

    Ji Nanbei was usually quite gentle when it came to this cute little sword fairy, except for occasionally teasing him.

    "I've known you for so long, and I still don't know your name."

    [To trigger the task, please choose one of the following three options to reply. 】

    Option 1: My name is not Hey, my name is Ji Nanbei! (Reward: 200,000 magic points, fifth-grade spiritual treasure "Blood Transforming Flying Knife".)

    Option 2: I don’t think our relationship is close enough that we can exchange names! (Reward: 20,000 magic points, third-level secret book "The Divine Art of Controlling the House".) Person 5

    Option three: Make up some random words to deal with. (Reward: 3,000 magic points and a random third-grade talisman.)

    Ji Nanbei glanced at the options and had an idea.

    To be honest, Ji Nanbei is almost used to this kind of tone in option two.

    Speaking of which, Ji Nanbei found that the risk of his identity being exposed seemed to be gradually decreasing.

    "My name carries a powerful curse, and those who know it will bring disaster to this world!"

    [Three thousand magic points were obtained, and the "Water Avoidance Talisman" has been stored in the system space. ] "Hey!? There is such a thing! No wonder you have refused to tell me your name."

    Xiao Jingxi said in surprise.
